strategy.thesis: Early-stage fund + accelerator for the Greater Southeast Asia region (Taiwan + Southeast Asia). Three core themes: AI, Blockchain, and Southeast Asia (ABS). Backs SaaS/enterprise software and consumer/marketplace startups, including omni-channel retail SaaS.

program.eligibility: Greater Southeast Asia startups; the region's leading startup accelerator, launched in 2010

application.how_to_apply: Apply to AppWorks Accelerator online; fund invests in accelerator alumni and direct deals

summary.en: Taipei-based early-stage VC and the region's leading accelerator, focused on Greater Southeast Asia (Taiwan + SEA). Fund III closed at US$150M, bringing AUM to US$212M. Backs SaaS/enterprise software (e.g. 91APP, Omnichat) and consumer marketplaces.
summary.local: 總部位於台北的早期創投與加速器,聚焦大東南亞(台灣+東南亞)。Fund III 募得 1.5 億美元,AUM 達 2.12 億美元,投資 SaaS/企業軟體(如 91APP、Omnichat)與消費/電商平台。

strategy.thesis: Sector-agnostic global seed-stage fund pursuing a 'First Check' strategy — investing in pre-product/market-fit companies across consumer, enterprise solutions and blockchain. Reserves >50% of Fund V for follow-on to pre-IPO.

summary.en: Global seed-stage fund founded 2014 with team in San Francisco, Taipei and Shanghai. Sector-agnostic 'First Check' investor spanning consumer to enterprise to blockchain. Closed $110M Fund V (2022), bringing committed capital to over $400M. Portfolio includes Calm, Flexport, Hims & Hers, 91APP, Pinkoi.
summary.local: 2014 年成立的全球種子期基金,團隊分布舊金山、台北、上海。採『第一張支票』策略、跨消費到企業到區塊鏈。2022 年募得 1.1 億美元 Fund V,累積管理資本超過 4 億美元。投資組合含 Calm、Flexport、Hims & Hers、91APP、Pinkoi。

funds.name: Hive Ventures Taiwan AI Renaissance Fund (debut)

strategy.thesis: Described as the first dedicated Data & AI fund in Taiwan. Invests in Data, AI and Enterprise Software — from data/ML infrastructure to AI-powered industrial automation — backing founders accelerating digital transformation of industry, with Taiwan as a launchpad to Asia. Usually the first institutional investor.

people.name: Hong Lu
people.role: Founding Chairman (formerly Softbank China Venture Capital)

summary.en: Taipei- and Singapore-based seed/early-stage VC describing itself as the first dedicated Data & AI fund in Taiwan. Closed a $13.5M debut fund on 30 June 2021 (LPs include Taiwan's NDF, MiTAC-Synnex, Unitech, GMI). Focuses on enterprise software/SaaS and AI infrastructure; portfolio includes InfuseAI, Canner, PROFET AI.
summary.local: 總部位於台北與新加坡的種子/早期創投,自稱台灣第一支專注 Data & AI 的基金。2021/6/30 完成 1,350 萬美元首支基金(LP 含國發基金、神達聯強、聯昌、廣閎科技)。聚焦企業軟體/SaaS 與 AI 基礎建設,投資組合含 InfuseAI、Canner、PROFET AI。

strategy.thesis: Taipei-based fund manager (founded 2009) running multiple funds plus a 2022 evergreen angel fund. Invests across Enterprise Applications, Consumer and Life Sciences, primarily in Taiwan and Silicon Valley, with Series A/B, late-stage and secondary exposure.

summary.en: Taipei-headquartered VC fund manager founded 2009 (offices in Hsinchu and the US). Has managed eight funds plus a 2022 evergreen angel fund, investing across Enterprise Applications, Consumer and Life Sciences in Taiwan and Silicon Valley. As of Dec 2024 it had invested in 69 companies with 1 unicorn, 11 IPOs and 7 acquisitions (incl. 17LIVE, KKday, Gamma).
summary.local: 總部位於台北、2009 年成立的創投基金管理公司(新竹及美國設辦公室)。已管理八支基金並於 2022 年成立常青天使基金,投資橫跨企業應用、消費與生技,主要在台灣與矽谷。截至 2024/12 投資 69 家公司,含 1 隻獨角獸、11 件 IPO、7 件併購(含 17LIVE、KKday、Gamma)。

US$150M, US$56M, US$200M) across deeptech and enterprise. One fund focuses on automation and enterprise SaaS, 5G/networking, advanced manufacturing and digital health. summary.local: 總部位於台北、2017 年由國發基金與民間企業共同成立的創投。管理多支基金(報導規模含 1.5 億、5,600 萬、2 億美元),橫跨深科技與企業。其中一支基金聚焦自動化與企業 SaaS、5G/網通、先進製造與數位健康。截至 2025/12 投資 75 家公司。主要為深科技,透過企業 SaaS 部分與本切片輕度重疊。

Founded by Chiu De-cheng; historically optoelectronics/IC-design focused with consumer/retail among its areas (e.g. PopChill marketplace). Generalist — only light overlap with the consumer/SaaS segment.
summary.local: 1996 年成立,台灣管理規模最大的創投之一,管理基金規模超過新台幣 120 億元、投資逾 250 家公司。創辦人邱德成;早期聚焦光電與 IC 設計,投資領域含消費/零售(如 PopChill 二手交易平台)。屬通用型,與消費/SaaS 切片僅輕度重疊。
